verdict.rationale: A test or sandbox environment is a fair axis for a tax-filing platform with a sanctioned third-party software channel. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, a test mode or test submissions isolated from production tax data. The evidence covers only production filing, certificates, a reference to the ERiC artifact host (now unreachable), and server status, none of which constitutes sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
